teaser: The suitcase stays half-packed, not from procrastination but readiness. You are a 5, numerology's restless catalyst for change, and an ENTJ, the type built to see an endgame and organize reality toward it. Most versions of this number pull a person toward scattering; this one turns scattering into a campaign. In a trailhead parking lot at six in the morning, gear sorted into the car before anyone else has found their boots, the itinerary gets drawn before the trail does. Freedom gets a plan here. That is the particular thing: wanting out, and wanting to run the exit.
